prompt: Read `docs/INGEST.md` FIRST and in full, then read `docs/PATCH-NOTES.md` in full, then read every file in `src/`, then answer. Return ONLY a JSON object: {"finding": "<what most collectors have in common, and why it matters>", "constraint": "<the naming rule INGEST.md records, in enough detail to act on>", "violations": ["<every collector id whose source field is an UNSANCTIONED violation of that rule, given what PATCH-NOTES.md sanctions -- empty array if none>"], "collectors": ["<every collector function you inspected>"]}. Read all fourteen collector files; do not sample a few and generalise. This is a read-only task: report what you found and change no file in the repository.

source.note: The complex sibling of `summarizer-retention-v1`, built for cell coverage (summarizer x complex) and dispatched the same way: the summarizer is not a dispatchable role, it runs only inside compaction, so this task dispatches an auditor, declares measuredRoles ["auditor", "summarizer"], and sets requiresCompaction so the runner records that compaction actually happened rather than measuring a run that merely fit in budget -- the mistake the medium task's first version made, scoring 1.00 in three turns with nothing evicted. This version is harder along the axis the medium task does not exercise: the medium task carries one constraint stated once and never restated, which is retained or lost. Here the constraint must ALSO be reconciled against a second document, PATCH-NOTES.md, that contradicts the naive reading of the first -- two of the fourteen collectors (12, 13) deliberately violate the literal rule in INGEST.md and are explicitly sanctioned by PATCH-NOTES.md, while a fifteenth-looking case, collector09's body reporting source: "collect07", is unsanctioned by either document and is the one real defect. Both documents sit at the START of the read, before the bulk of fourteen near-identical files, so both are equally exposed to eviction; an answer that kept only INGEST.md would wrongly flag 12 and 13, and an answer that kept neither would report no constraint and no violation at all. Not yet calibrated live -- to be run per the method before it is trusted.
